description: 4-tap 16x16 MAC with serial accumulate chain and end-of-path saturation. Violates timing at 2.0 ns on nangate45 by construction — the optimisation target.

known_bottlenecks: serial adder chain (s0->s1->s2->s3) instead of a balanced tree
four unpipelined 16x16 multipliers in one cycle
40-bit saturation compare in series after the accumulate
notes.invariants: rewrites must preserve 2-cycle latency and bit-exact outputs
